events.title: Tribute to Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential American rapper and actor Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this week, we lost a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is still felt profoundly today. What's your go-to track from the legend?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: This week marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix, a true pioneer who redefined the electric guitar, left us too soon this week. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago today in 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles crossed that road and delivered a masterpiece! 'Abbey Road' is a timeless classic. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's 75th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman is still rocking. What's your top Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic English singer and co-founder of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: Imagine turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod 25 years ago today in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod's 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond song ever?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon's 86th
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire peace and love around the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of The White Album! The Beatles delivered a double LP full of diverse tracks. Which deep cut is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen performance?

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and powerful message of peace continue to echo globally. What's his most impactful song for you?
